method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, eparchial, and parish directories were used to establish named Eastern Orthodox bodies in Brazil. Search engines, maps, and the 2025 Brazilian inter-Orthodox directory were used only for discovery. Historical bodies, construction-only sites, bodies outside Eastern Orthodox communion, and communities without current competent jurisdictional confirmation were not converted into directory rows.

candidates.status: hold until a current first-party vicariate roster names it
candidates.reason: The 2025 Brazilian inter-Orthodox directory names this cathedral under the Antiochian Patriarchal Vicariate of Rio de Janeiro, but the competent current patriarchal source presently establishes only the vicariate itself and does not expose a subordinate parish roster. The vicariate is published while this discovered body remains held.

exclusions.result: The Antiochian Patriarchal Vicariate stated in 2020 that the named Penha communities and clergy had severed communion with the Patriarchate of Antioch. They are not published as current Antiochian bodies. This is based on the competent jurisdiction's own notice and does not extend to other communities.

exclusions.scope: Armenian Apostolic, Syriac Orthodox, and Coptic Orthodox bodies
exclusions.result: These communities belong to the Oriental Orthodox family and are outside this Eastern Orthodox directory. Their exclusion is a scope boundary and makes no judgment about their religious identity or history.
Searches for Ukrainian churches in Brazil prominently return Eastern Catholic parishes and eparchial bodies. They are not Eastern Orthodox and are not converted into directory rows.

Only the seven Brazil worship bodies returned by the current official ROCOR worldwide directory are published. Older directories, social pages, and map records do not establish current diocesan placement for omitted bodies.

Search and map listings using Orthodox names are not published without a current competent canonical synodal or diocesan source that establishes jurisdictional placement. This is an evidence threshold, not a general judgment about every independently named community.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Ecumenical Patriarchate, Greek Orthodox Metropolis of Buenos Aires
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The official 2024 archdiocesan clarification names thirteen Brazil bodies and states that other bodies outside its list do not belong to its jurisdiction. All thirteen named bodies are published. The source was recounted directly rather than relying on an earlier seven-body expectation.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Ecumenical Patriarchate, Ukrainian Orthodox Eparchy of South America
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official roster names eighteen Brazil bodies. All eighteen are published under the existing South America eparchy parent. The direct eparchy row created by the Argentina module is not duplicated here.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Antiochian Orthodox Archdiocese of São Paulo and All Brazil
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official parish page names nineteen subordinate bodies. The archdiocese's official history identifies its São Paulo cathedral. The cathedral and all nineteen roster bodies are published for a total of twenty.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Antiochian Patriarchal Vicariate of Rio de Janeiro
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current Antiochian Patriarchate directory establishes the Rio de Janeiro patriarchal vicariate, which is published as one direct child of Antioch. Five subordinate bodies discovered in the 2025 Brazilian inter-Orthodox directory remain held because no current first-party vicariate roster was found.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Moscow Patriarchate, Diocese of Argentina and South America
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official diocesan roster names nine Brazil worship bodies. All nine are published under the existing Argentina and South America diocese parent.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Serbian Orthodox Eparchy of Buenos Aires and South-Central America
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official 2025 diocesan directory names ten Brazil bodies. All ten are published with their present directory ranks. The Raposa body is also named by the current Polish Orthodox Church roster; both competent current claims are preserved neutrally under their respective parents.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Polish Orthodox Church, Missionary Diocese of Rio de Janeiro and Olinda-Recife
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official Polish Orthodox Church page names twelve Brazil bodies. All twelve are published. The Raposa body overlaps a current Serbian diocesan listing at the same address and with the same priest; each jurisdiction's current first-party claim is preserved without choosing between them. The Recife entry's Portuguese dedication is Teofania do Senhor while its Polish parenthetical differs, so the row preserves the local title. Five bodies found in an external 2025 directory but omitted from the current Polish roster remain held.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Russian Orthodox Church Outside of Russia, Diocese of South America
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official worldwide directory contains seven Brazil worship-body listings. All seven are published under the existing South America diocese parent.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Romanian Orthodox Metropolia of the Americas
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official parish directory and current almanac were checked and did not name a Brazil body. This is a bounded roster result, not a country-level absence claim.
The current official parish directory was checked and did not name a Brazil body. This is a bounded roster result, not a country-level absence claim.

The current official diaspora structures checked for this audit did not establish an exact current Brazil body. Search-discovered True Orthodox and independently named communities were not published without a competent current Bulgarian synodal or diocesan citation.

No exact current Brazil worship body is published without a current first-party patriarchal or diocesan citation. General references to South America do not establish a specific operating Brazil body. This is a bounded source result, not a general absence claim.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Ukrainian Orthodox Church and Orthodox Church of Ukraine
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: No separate current Brazil body is published under either jurisdiction. The competent current source for the named Ukrainian Orthodox communities in Brazil is the Ecumenical Patriarchate's South America eparchy roster. This placement avoids duplicating the same communities under another jurisdiction.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Other canonical Local Churches and diaspora structures
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: No additional Brazil row is published without an exact current first-party jurisdictional citation. This records incomplete verification for jurisdictions not individually listed above and makes no general country-level absence claim.
